job.title: Senior Data Migration Engineer
job.description:
Senior Data Migration Engineer | 12-Month Contract | Canberra | NV2 Clearance
  
About the opportunity
A leading global professional services and technology consulting firm is looking for a Senior Data Migration Engineer for a 12-month contract, starting mid-September. Canberra is preferred, with Melbourne or Sydney also considered. You'll lead the migration of structured and unstructured data from legacy platforms to Google Cloud Platform, building the automation, data architecture and governance that underpins a large-scale migration program.
  
The role
  • Automate enterprise-scale data discovery using advanced PowerShell, including metadata/permission capture, Active Directory integration, scheduling, logging, auditing and recovery
  • Design metadata repositories and data models, from conceptual through to physical, in SQL Server
  • Build robust SSIS/ETL pipelines ingesting database and file-based sources, with transformation, cleansing, validation and incremental loading
  • Lead end-to-end migration of structured and unstructured data to GCP (including Cloud Storage), preserving metadata and permissions, with reconciliation and post-migration verification
  • Design migration approaches, plan waves, manage dependencies and risks, and produce runbooks, cutover plans and rollback procedures
  • Deliver migration-readiness, operational, executive, governance and compliance reporting via Power BI and DAX
  • Establish engineering standards and coordinate delivery across business, infrastructure, security and application teams
  
What you'll bring
  • Advanced PowerShell for enterprise-scale data discovery and automation
  • Strong SQL Server capability, including data modelling, stored procedures, optimisation and reconciliation
  • Proven SSIS/ETL experience
  • End-to-end cloud migration delivery experience, ideally to GCP
  • Experience designing migration strategy, cutover plans and rollback procedures
  • Power BI and DAX reporting experience
NV2 security clearance
  
Apply now to lead a large-scale, security-conscious data migration program.

job.title: SIEM Subject Matter Expert (Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSIAM) - Contract
job.description:
About the Role
 
3 Month Contract 
Sydney 

Our client is seeking an experienced SIEM Subject Matter Expert with deep Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSIAM expertise for an initial 3-month contract engagement with strong potential for extension.
 
In this hands-on delivery role, you will take end-to-end ownership of the enterprise SIEM data pipeline, from log source onboarding, parsing and normalisation through to telemetry enrichment, alert fidelity tuning and platform health management. Combining deep technical capability with an automation mindset, you'll streamline how new data sources are connected to ensure security analysts have complete, high-quality context directly within the platform.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Log Source Onboarding: Onboard diverse enterprise log sources, leading log parsing, field extraction, data modelling and normalisation to common information models
  • Automation & Tooling: Design, build and maintain automated onboarding tooling (via scripting, APIs or native capabilities) to reduce manual effort and accelerate data connection times
  • Telemetry Enrichment: Manage enrichment pipelines that append critical context (asset ownership, identity, business criticality and threat intelligence) to raw log events, eliminating the need for analysts to pivot between tools
  • Detection & Alert Tuning: Fine-tune SIEM configurations and detection content to measurably reduce false positives and elevate overall signal quality
  • Platform Lifecycle Management: Proactively oversee SIEM platform health, performance monitoring, capacity management, connector/collector maintenance and platform upgrades
Core Requirements
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSIAM, including log ingestion using Broker VMs, XDR Collectors and custom ingestion methods
  • Proven capability developing SIEM data models, field mapping, enrichment and schema standardisation across varied enterprise data feeds
  • Experience leveraging scripting, APIs or native tools to automate log source onboarding workflows
  • Strong proficiency in regular expressions (Regex), JSON parsing, structured log analysis and telemetry enrichment
  • Track record of optimising detection content to reduce false positives and managing capacity, performance and collector maintenance
  • Must be based in Sydney (or able to work hybrid onsite) and hold full, unrestricted Australian working rights
Desirable Skills
  • Palo Alto Networks certifications (e.g. PCSAE or equivalent Cortex credentials)
  • Proficiency in XQL or similar log query languages
  • Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework
  • Exposure to adjacent SIEM technologies (e.g. Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar)
  • Prior background working within an enterprise SOC, MSSP or complex security operations environment

You are an experienced Data and AI leader who combines technical credibility with strong commercial awareness. You can engage confidently with business leaders, understand their challenges and translate these into realistic solutions for technical teams to deliver.
You are proactive, naturally curious and comfortable setting direction rather than waiting for requirements to be provided. Most importantly, you are a hands-on leader who enjoys turning ideas into measurable outcomes.

  • Practical experience delivering AI projects from concept through to implementation.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer (Platform)
job.description:
This role would suit someone who is a strong Senior C# Engineer looking to work in a Platform team: build Bicep IaC, Azure serverless tooling & dev blueprints that make every other engineer's life easier.

Role Overview
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. This role is focused on infrastructure and platform capability, not on building product APIs. You'll design and write Infrastructure as Code, build the templates and blueprints that other developers rely on, and help evolve how the wider engineering organisation builds, tests, and ships software.

This role suits someone who genuinely enjoys "just" doing infrastructure as code and who wants to make life better for the developers who use what you build.

While this role has a strong focus on Infrastructure as Code and Azure platform engineering, we're specifically looking for an experienced Senior C# engineer who enjoys applying software engineering practices to cloud infrastructure and platform development.

Key Responsibilities:
Infrastructure as Code & Platform Capability
  • Write, maintain, and improve Infrastructure as Code across Azure.
  • Build and maintain reusable Bicep templates and modules that other developers can consume directly.
  • Write unit tests for infrastructure code, treating it with the same rigour as application code.
  • Design everything with a dev-centric mindset - the goal is to make it easy and intuitive for other engineers to self-serve infrastructure, not just to make it work.
  • Produce blueprints and reference architectures, supported by clear diagrams, that development teams can pick up and use with minimal guidance.
Cloud Architecture
  • Design, build, and maintain platform tooling and automation using C#.
  • Apply current Microsoft Landing Zone patterns and practices.
  • Design and build with Azure-native services including Event Grid, Front Door, Azure Functions, and Logic Apps.
  • Default to serverless architectures wherever practical, particularly for lower-traffic workloads, to reduce cost and operational overhead.
Platform & Delivery
  • Support and help drive the GitHub migration, including following it through to completion across affected teams.
  • Contribute to the CI/CD platform and identify practical ways to accelerate software delivery.
  • Write clear technical designs, including Key Design Decisions (KDDs) and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and maintain good record-keeping practices.
  • Explore and apply AI tooling to improve engineering and delivery workflows.
Ways of Working & Communication
  • Participate in Three Amigos sessions as part of the team's ways of working.
  • Review pull requests thoughtfully and provide constructive, timely feedback.
  • Communicate clearly with both engineers and stakeholders, particularly when explaining infrastructure and platform decisions.
About You
  • Senior-level experience in cloud application development is preferred. Candidates who demonstrate an interest in platform engineering and a willingness to develop platform-focused expertise will be highly valued.
  • Strong hands-on Senior level experience with .NET on Azure and/or AWS
  • Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code tooling: Bicep, Terraform, Pulumi, or AWS CDK.
  • Familiarity with current Microsoft Landing Zone architecture and patterns is preferred.
  • Experience with serverless services such as Event Grid, Front Door, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, or equivalent AWS services.
  • Comfortable writing unit tests for infrastructure and platform code.
  • A genuine platform mindset - motivated by enabling other developers rather than shipping product features directly.
  • Experience with, or strong interest in, GitHub-based CI/CD and developer workflow tooling.

Role is based in Melbourne CBD
Offered as a Hybrid, with 1-2 office days per week. 
Contract: 6months initially - extendible depending on performance/project
Daily Rate: starting at $1000+ per day. 

Only applicants with full working rights and based in Melbourne will be considered for this role. Please make sure you have your location on your resume when applying.
